text: fde-console（DSH 网页插件）：为本机 AI 编程智能体提供可查看、整理工作的团队工作台。它通过 DSH 网页客户端的侧栏入口打开中间主面板，并在本机启动工作台 API 与界面。工作台包含任务看板、任务雷达收件箱、成员进度、团队活动和智能体会话查看；还能汇总会话、任务和活动生成日报或周报。适合需要把多个智能体的会话与团队任务放在同一处跟进的 DSH 用户。可选启用 Gitea 或 GitHub 组织活动源；需使用 DSH 网页客户端。

fde-console is a DSH web workbench for tracking team tasks and AI coding agents. Its sidebar opens a main panel with a task board, agent session views, team activity, and daily or weekly reports. Local sessions and task data are brought together; Gitea and GitHub organization feeds are optional.
想在 DSH 里用看板跟踪任务、负责人和截止日期。
有没有办法集中查看不同 AI 编程助手最近的会话和项目？
I want a daily or weekly summary of agent sessions and task progress.
fde-console 的功能「任务看板」：在网页工作台中创建并跟进任务，维护状态、负责人、优先级、截止日期与任务记录。用户从看板视图查看和更新任务；任务数据由工作台路由读取和保存。
fde-console 的功能「智能体观测与报告」：汇总本机多个智能体来源的会话和项目活动，并可查看会话记录；日报或周报将会话、任务、提交活动与人工日报整理成 Markdown 内容。用户在智能体和总览相关视图查看这些信息。
fde-console 使用前须知：启用组织活动源后会向 Gitea 或 GitHub 请求提交与 PR 动态；GitHub 活动源默认关闭，认证信息可从 git config 读取。

fde-console README · fde-console — Super Workbench：[English](README.md) | [中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

A local-first workbench plugin for [DSH](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) that turns your local AI coding agents (ZCode, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, DSH, WorkBuddy…) into an **observable, accountable agent team**.

**The core loop: See → Understand → Attribute → Accept.**

fde-console README · fde-console — Super Workbench：- **See** — live agent activity across six local session sources (per-project feed, running-now section, 28-day heatmap)
- **Understand** — full transcript reader per session, plus the *dispatch prompt*: the original human instruction behind each session
- **Attribute** — commits and sessions auto-attached to tasks via a branch/markdown convention ([docs/ATTRIBUTION.md](docs/ATTRIBUTION.md)), with a repo guard against cross-repo false matches
- **Accept** — evidence lives on the task: timeline, session evidence with one-click confirm, daily/weekly reports with Markdown export

fde-console README · fde-console — Super Workbench：**Local-first by design:** no cloud, no third-party runtime dependencies (Node built-ins only), all data in one directory you own. Agent sessions are read-only observed — the workbench never writes into your agents.

fde-console README · Features：- **Task board** — kanban with timeline, acceptor sign-off, deep links, priorities, due dates, daily diary per task
- **Agent observation** — six-source adapters, session lists, transcript reader, running-now detection, per-project tabs
- **Work search** — `Ctrl+K` across task titles, session titles, commit messages and diaries
- **Dispatch prompts** — see the original instruction each agent session was started with
- **Session evidence** — suggested attachments scored per task, one-click or batch confirm
- **Reports** — auto-generated daily digest and weekly review, exportable as Markdown
- **Heatmap & scorecards** — 28-day activity grid per agent; SVG scorecard endpoints
- **Integrations** — MCP server (stdio) so your agents can query the board; webhook out; IM notify (Feishu/DingTalk bots); Gitea/GitHub/Gitee activity feeds
- **Governance** — credential never touches disk (git config runtime read), redaction on every output, SSRF allowlist for all outbound, single-instance lock with warning, backup/restore

fde-console README · Demo dataset：Want a populated workbench before connecting anything? Seed a fully synthetic dataset (members, tasks, minutes, inbox candidates, team events — placeholder names only, zero network):

```bash
node scripts/seed-demo.js                          # seeds the default data dir (~/.dsh/fde-console/data)
node scripts/seed-demo.js --data-dir <dir> --force # custom dir / overwrite
```

fde-console README · Demo dataset：Then start the instance and explore; delete the seeded JSON files to reset. The seed goes through the JSON storage channel, so it targets fresh (un-migrated) data dirs — the script refuses a migrated (SQLite) target and asks you to use a new directory.

fde-console README · The six views：| View | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Overview | stats, agent heatmap, digital-worker reports (daily/weekly), version matrix |
| Task Radar | meeting transcripts → AI task decomposition → inbox gate |
| Task Board | kanban: timeline, acceptor, deep links, diary, project filters |
| Agents | live activity feed across six sources + session reader |
| Members | desktop agents + human members: status, output, diary nudge |
| Team Activity | multi-source commit/PR feed with task attribution |
| Settings | sources, engine, security allowlist, one-click env check |

fde-console README · Attribution protocol：AI-made commits can self-attach to tasks with three conventions: branch `task/<id>`, marker `[#<id>]` in the message, or binding the task to a project directory. See [docs/ATTRIBUTION.md](docs/ATTRIBUTION.md) — includes a ready-to-paste snippet for your own `AGENTS.md` and a `commit-msg` hook.

Writing your own session-source adapter (Cursor, Trae, Aider…): see [docs/ADAPTERS.md](docs/ADAPTERS.md).

fde-console README · MCP server：`scripts/mcp-server.mjs` exposes read-only tools (list tasks / search work / agent status) over stdio, so any MCP client can query the workbench:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "fde": { "command": "node", "args": ["<repo>/scripts/mcp-server.mjs"] } } }
```

| Gitea 组织 feeds | 默认启用 | `data/activities.json` + `data/gitea-status.json` | `git config --global http.https://gitea.example.com/.extraheader "Authorization: Basic xxx"` |
| GitHub org events | 默认关闭 | 同一 `activities.json` + 独立 `data/github-status.json` | `git config --global http.https://api.github.com/.extraheader "Authorization: Bearer ghp_xxx"` |

fde-console README · 数据源接入：启用 GitHub（v2.9.17 起设置页可配）：「设置 → GitHub 动态源」卡片——开启用开关（启用时组织名必填）、填组织名、保存即热生效（随下个轮询周期，无需重启）。私库先配令牌（页面有命令模板可复制）：`git config --global http.https://api.github.com/.extraheader "Authorization: Bearer <PAT>"`（细粒度 PAT 需目标仓库 Contents: Read；公共组织匿名可拉，限流 60 次/时/IP）。备用口径：手改 config.json 的 `github` 节后重启。自建 GitHub Enterprise：先手改 config.json 的 `github.hostWhitelist` 加 host，再在页面改 API 地址。两源独立容错：单源失败不拖垮另一源，各自 status 文件留痕；动态页来源标示自动变为「Gitea · GitHub（org）」。

fde-console README · 数据源接入：多源说明：三源映射到同一套活动词表（commit/pr/branch_created/branch_deleted）与同一 `activities.json`，归因/日报预填/总览统计自动吃到 GitHub/Gitee 数据；成员册条目用 `githubLogin`/`giteeLogin` 字段认领对应平台 actor（与 giteaLogin 同规格，≤50 字符）。Gitee 源设置页可配（v2.9.18，「设置 → Gitee 动态源」，保存热生效）；令牌无效时源状态 ok:false 但不拖垮其他源。

成员册口径（v2.9.1 起）：人类成员 = 手工名册 ∪ Gitea 组织接口缓存；**动态流 actor 不再自动入册**（团队动态页仍照常显示未登记账号）。管理员/机器人类组织账号用 `gitea.ignoreLogins` 排除（默认 `["admin"]`，config.json 手改，大小写不敏感，自定义名单整体替换默认）。
